caseNameFull: John Bruce HUBBARD v. UNITED STATES

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit granted limited to the following question: Whether petitioner’s convictions under 18 U.S.C. 1001 for knowingly making false statements in pleadings filed with the bankruptcy court are barred by the so-called “judicial functionn” exception of Section 1001.
